summary.text: Iris Rudder is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 39, where she has served since November 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rudder is the only candidate listed for the District 39 general election.

paragraphs.text: Iris Rudder was first elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 39 in 2018 and took office on November 6, 2018.
In the 2023–2024 session she was assigned to the Health, Insurance, Naming and Designating, and State Government committees.
